services.value: Rose City Labs provides environmental and product testing services including microbiological testing, water quality testing (e.g., heavy metals, lead, arsenic, radon, PFAS, and coliform/E.coli), mold/indoor air quality testing, radon testing, asbestos surveys/testing, legionella testing, and pesticides testing. They also provide cannabis and hemp-related compliance testing (including OLCC compliance testing for potency, pesticides, water activity, moisture content, residual solvents, mycotoxins, heavy metals, and microbiological screening), along with product testing such as psilocybin testing, plant virus/pathogen testing, genetics and gender ID, and terpenes - R&D testing.
